visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Several people stand around a table covered in aluminum foil, which is piled high with cooked red crawfish, yellow corn cobs, and potatoes. They use their hands to peel and eat the food, placing shells into large neon green plastic buckets. (2) Two individuals carry a large, perforated stainless steel pot filled with steaming crawfish and vegetables through a doorway. Steam billows from the top of the pot as they move into a brightly lit indoor kitchen area. (3) A person wearing red oven mitts tilts the large metal pot, pouring a massive quantity of steaming red crawfish, corn, and potatoes directly onto the aluminum-foil-covered center island of a kitchen. (4) A hand reaches into the frame and sprinkles fresh green chopped herbs from a white plate over the large steaming pile of crawfish and vegetables. A yellow spice container is visible in the background on the counter. (5) Close-up shots show the details of the feast: bright red crawfish, yellow corn on the cob, white onions, and potatoes. Multiple hands are visible busily peeling crawfish and picking up food to eat. (6) People continue to gather around the table, eating socially. They use green buckets for disposal. White subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen.
